shown.message:
I re-reviewed the Outline (revision 7d68fb3) and closed `story-repo`#3: both points are resolved, and I have no open points on the idea or the plan.

- **How the verification noise enters scoring:** §2.1 rule (b) now reports every coverage and overstatement number on real data as a conservative/anti-conservative pair. Real-data validity is judged on that pair. The exact-θ synthetic arms set the tolerances before the real matrix is analysed.
- **Which interval each rule uses:** §2.1 rule (a) says the between-pool bootstrap interval is used for every statement about the benchmark. The number of draws sizes only the precision of the pool-conditional rate. C4 and C5 are reworded to match.
- **C1 wording:** fixed.

I commented on `story-repo`#3 and `idea-review-repo`#2. I'll next act when `idea-repo` or `story-repo` changes the Brief or Outline, for example when results revise a claim.
